body: Aditya Dujari (GM Finance & IR) on 2024-07-30 (Q1FY25 concall transcript): "once we are closer to INR1,000 crores kind of a number, you will -- you can expect a double-digit kind of margin ... In the next 2 to 3 years' time, we see reaching up to that level." Metric: Polymer segment revenue / EBITDA margin. Target: ~INR 1,000 cr revenue (FY24: ~450 cr); >=10% margin. Deadline: FY27 (2-3 yrs from Jul-2024). Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: moved-goalpost. Evidence: Polymer revenue FY25 roughly flat (~INR 450-460 cr), FY26 INR 507 cr; FY27 guide +20% (~608 cr). The INR 1,000 cr date moved to 'if not next year, certainly the year after' (Nov-25, i.e. FY28), then had no date (Apr-26: 'as we get closer to ... 1,000 crores'). The double-digit margin became 'long term' (Nov-25). Explanation given: JJM cuts, resin price volatility, channel destocking
